content.short: Building a cross-chain web3 learning platform empowering the creators of tomorrow.
content.description:
Our mission was to create a first of its kind blockchain-enabled learning platform. By using new technologies we believe that it’s possible to unlock a whole new paradigm of incentives that will reward both learners and creators in a fair way. We call this Learn And Earn.

Building with the power of web3 technology allowed us to create the first cross-chain enabled web3 Learn and Earn platform from scratch using our $WORK token as the backbone behind the entire platform and eco-system.

We have built a solution that will be one of the first stepping stones to help induce healthy daily learning habits and offer a fair unique monetization model for content creators to earn.
